verdict.rationale: Unity ships AI features (the AI Assistant, asset generators and an MCP server), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents an opt-out, data-usage policy or setting that keeps user data out of AI model training. Community comments about telemetry 'phoning home' are not about AI training, so they are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
